scope: Targeted SMB allocation/EA and NFS allocation expansion, before MxAc follow-up; not full conformance

checks: CREATE/QUERY/SET persistent DOS attributes, zero/no-change and NORMAL semantics; readonly open/delete checks and granted-handle authority
four independent timestamps, native mtime, zero/no-change, per-handle explicit/-1 freeze and -2 re-enable; invalid times reject before attribute mutation
binary extended attributes on CREATE/QUERY/SET, case-insensitive updates, deletion, restart, NEED_EA and access rights; malformed chains reject atomically
attributes follow native object across rename/restart, directory invariants hold, replacement object does not inherit stale metadata
per-open mode CREATE/QUERY/SET and FileAllInformation agreement, write-through writes, independent handles, invalid synchronous/immutable modes and SMB2 ignored synchronous CREATE flags
EA cursor paging, restart, single-entry and explicit indexes, independent opens, bounded whole-entry overflow and undersized-buffer retries
selected-name EA queries preserve request order and scan cursor, ignore index/restart, match case-insensitively, return absent names, bound output and reject malformed chains without cursor changes
EA writes atomically update change time/archive while respecting frozen timestamps; exact 65531-byte aggregate limit and standard invalid-name/list statuses
v3 CREATE preserves mode, mapped ownership and explicit atime/mtime on native handles
v3 ctime differs from preserved mtime and advances for mode-only metadata changes across export aliases
v4 SETATTR updates aliases consistently; GETATTR rejects write-only time attributes
durable change counters detect equal-size writes with restored mtime, share alias state and return real namespace change_info; reads do not advance them
v3 used and v4 space_used match independent native allocation for empty, small, sparse/extended and truncated files, separately from logical size
paged v4 READDIR skips reserved cookies 1/2 and resumes without duplicate or missing entries
mode/ownership and exact timestamps survive server restart through stable alias handles
schema v4 migration preserves a pre-v5 backup before adding durable reservations
native space allocation preserves EOF, charges quota once, rejects over-quota growth before mutation and enforces WRITE_DATA
durable logical quota survives restart while allocation reports native close-time trimming; EOF extension consumes reservations; shrink and deletion release quota
AlSi CREATE/overwrite preallocation preserves zero EOF, charges durable quota, ignores existing opens/directories, validates context shape and fails over-quota before namespace/data mutation
NEGOTIATE respects requested credits, grants one when zero was requested and caps the window at 8192
bounded credit window tolerates delayed sequence IDs across 128 requests and still rejects replay
SMB-style wildcard bootstrap preserves SMB3.1.1 preauth/signing; SMB1-only, malformed and repeated probes rejected
